fact.en: Thinking Jainism began with Mahavira: Mahavira was the 24th Tirthankara; Jainism has ancient roots.

fact.en: Confusing the councils: First council (Pataliputra) tried to compile Agamas, Second (Valabhi) formalised the sect divide.

fact.en: Believing Digambaras follow the Agamas: They reject the canonical status of the Svetambara Agamas.
